tweets.text: Step 3: Plan harder, implement faster. Florian, Imanol, and Kirill all landed on the same pattern. Use a slow thinking model for planning. Hand off to a fast model for execution. tweets.text: Step 4: Build verification loops. The person who wrote the code is the worst person to review it. A fresh agent session has no attachment to what it's looking at. The bottleneck has shifted from writing code to verifying it. That's the unlock. Everything else is theater. Full post: kilo.codes/nh4QKzW
